name: La Puebla de Cazalla (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of white, dark green and earth-coloured khaki, with an eight-pointed star outline at the upper hoist and the crowned municipal arms of La Puebla de Cazalla at the centre (a crescent on red and a tree on white).
history: Approved in March 2017 after a popular vote, the flag is rectangular and composed of three equal horizontal stripes, white above, green in the centre and earth-coloured below.

features.role: outlined eight-pointed star at the upper hoist
